title: Body, Figure, and Observation Drawing
summary: Students move from garment-only language into fashion-figure observation language. They learn body-reference points, figure and croquis vocabulary, pose and view language, and short respectful description frames for fashion figures, silhouettes, and visible garment features.
essential_question: How can I describe a fashion figure, pose, and sketch clearly in simple English for Fashion Design study?
professional_context: Week 5 connects English to observation drawing, fashion figure work, croquis reading, and beginner sketch description. Students need this language to identify body-reference points, talk about front and side views, describe garments on the figure, and comment on silhouette, outline, and visible design features without shifting into personal-body judgment.
grammar_focus: This is a fashion figure / sketch / croquis
This is a front view / side view / back view
The figure is standing / walking / sitting
The pose is simple / relaxed / straight
The hem is above the knee / below the knee
adjective order in simple design description
plural body-reference nouns such as shoulders and legs
teacher_preparation: Preview the Week 5 opener board, the body-reference diagram, the figure-sketch vocabulary board, the labeled figure image, and the four-figure gallery before class.
Prepare visible sentence frames for This is a fashion figure, The figure is, The pose is, The figure is wearing, The silhouette is, and The hem is below the knee or above the knee.
Review the Week 5 correction targets, especially missing is, The figure is wearing, adjective order, and below the knee.
Decide whether students will complete the Fashion Figure Description Card from a projected gallery, printed cards, or a future app gallery.
Bring or project the four-figure gallery for listening, reading, writing, and the teacher speaking session.
student_deliverables: Completion of the Week 5 review opener.
Completion of the main body and figure vocabulary matching sets.
Completion of the figure-labeling task using labeled point keys.
Listening-comprehension responses identifying pose, view, and garment details from one audio clip.
Reading-comprehension responses matching sketch captions to visible figure images.
Completion of controlled phrase-practice frames for fashion-figure description.
A scaffolded Fashion Figure Description Card with 5 to 6 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge line.
One corrected Week 5 sentence saved after review.
A short teacher-observed oral sketch description using prepared sentence frames.
